title: RDQ: Residual Distribution Quantization for Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2607.10137v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Post-training quantization (PTQ) of large language models degrades sharply below 4-bit precision. We identify the root cause as residual stream distributional drift: quantization noise injected at each transformer layer accumulates in the shared residual representation, causing KL divergence from the FP16 baseline to grow super-linearly with depth (Pearson r=0.999 with log-perplexity, p<0.001, confirmed across all tested methods and bit-widths). translated_title: RDQ：面向大语言模型的残差分布量化
translated_abstract: 大语言模型的后训练量化（PTQ）在低于4比特精度时性能会急剧退化。我们将这一问题的根本原因确定为残差流分布漂移：在每个Transformer层注入的量化噪声会在共享的残差表示中不断累积，导致与FP16基线的KL散度随深度呈超线性增长（与对数困惑度的Pearson相关系数r=0.999，p<0.001，且在所有测试方法和比特宽度下均得到验证）。我们发现LLaMA-3-8B中84%的层表现出非高斯残差分布（KS检验，p≤0.05），并且每层残差流方差随深度增长达6,548倍。我们提出了RDQ（残差分布量化），这是一个PTQ框架，其核心贡献是级联误差补偿（CEC）：一种顺序校准流程，通过让校准数据流经已量化的上游层，捕获每层实际接收到的漂移激活值并……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 该论文揭示了残差流分布漂移是大语言模型低比特后训练量化性能急剧退化的根本原因，并提出了RDQ框架，通过级联误差补偿（CEC）机制捕获每层实际接收到的漂移激活值，显著提升低比特量化的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies residual stream distributional drift as the root cause of sharp degradation in sub-4-bit post-training quantization of LLMs, and proposes RDQ with Cascaded Error Compensation (CEC) to capture the actual drifted activations each layer receives, significantly improving low-bit quantization performance.
